data.title: AiTM Session Token Replay — Same SessionId from Multiple IPs
data.description: Detects potential AiTM session token replay by identifying the same Entra ID SessionId appearing from multiple IP addresses within a short time window. In an AiTM attack, the phishing proxy IP and the attacker's actual replay IP both appear on the same session. This is the single strongest AiTM detection signal in Microsoft Entra ID sign-in logs. Additional confidence comes from the error code sequence 50074 (MFA required) → 50140 (Keep Me Signed In) → 0 (success) in rapid succession with medium or high risk level.

detection.condition: count(distinct IPAddress) by SessionId >= 2 AND timeframe < 4 hours

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for AiTM Session Token Replay Detection
// Detects same SessionId used from multiple IPs (proxy + attacker)
#repo="azure_signinlogs"
ResultType="0"
| groupBy([SessionId, UserPrincipalName], function=[count(field=IPAddress, distinct=true, as=IPCount), collect([IPAddress], as=IPs), collect([UserAgent], as=UserAgents), collect([AppId], as=AppIds), min(@timestamp, as=MinTime), max(@timestamp, as=MaxTime), collect([RiskLevelDuringSignIn], as=RiskLevels)], span=4h)
| IPCount >= 2
| select([UserPrincipalName, SessionId, IPCount, IPs, UserAgents,
          AppIds, MinTime, MaxTime, RiskLevels])
| sort(IPCount, order=desc)
queries.kql:
// KQL: AiTM Session Token Replay Detection
// Detects same SessionId used from multiple IPs (proxy + attacker)
let timeWindow = 4h;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    IPCount = dcount(IPAddress),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent),
    AppIds = make_set(AppId),
    MinTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    MaxTime = max(TimeGenerated),
    RiskLevels = make_set(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)
  by SessionId, UserPrincipalName
| where IPCount >= 2
| where datetime_diff('hour', MaxTime, MinTime) <= 4
| project UserPrincipalName, SessionId, IPCount, IPs, UserAgents,
          AppIds, MinTime, MaxTime, RiskLevels
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AiTM Session Token Replay Detection")`
`comment("Same SessionId from multiple IPs indicates token replay")`
index=azure sourcetype=azure:aad:signin ResultType=0
| stats dc(IPAddress) AS ip_count,
        values(IPAddress) AS ips,
        values(UserAgent) AS user_agents,
        values(AppId) AS app_ids,
        min(_time) AS first_seen,
        max(_time) AS last_seen,
        values(RiskLevelDuringSignIn) AS risk_levels
  BY SessionId, UserPrincipalName
| where ip_count >= 2
| eval window_hours = round((last_seen - first_seen) / 3600, 2)
| where window_hours <= 4
| sort - ip_count

references: Phishing kits and AiTM platforms: a comprehensive threat intelligence reference (2026)
falsepositives: Users connecting through VPN that changes IP mid-session
Load-balanced corporate proxies presenting different egress IPs
Mobile users transitioning between WiFi and cellular networks
